manifesto: I'm a software engineer who builds enterprise web products — the interface, the API, the data model underneath, and the AI features on top. You get one person who can take a feature from a rough idea to something running in production.

Over five years I've moved from frontend work on enterprise Angular apps to full-stack and AI-powered delivery at Bridginex: built and shipped AI recruitment and matching platforms processing 1,500+ candidate profiles, an enterprise CRM now running operations for a 1,000+ member community, and 100+ production REST APIs.

I build with AI in the loop — using OpenAI APIs, Cursor, and MCP to move faster from requirements to shipped features without cutting quality. Based in Surat and available for contract and freelance work, anywhere remote.
